info.title: Arbitrum JSON-RPC (spike)
info.description: Hand-written mini OpenAPI 3.1 document. One fake path per JSON-RPC method.

post.description: Returns the block number and the raw block metadata of each block in the range from `fromBlock` to `toBlock` that has metadata. Returns an error if the node does not serve block metadata, if `fromBlock` is greater than `toBlock`, or if the range exceeds the configured block limit.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns an error if the transaction publisher of the node, such as its sequencer or its transaction forwarder, is not healthy. Returns `null` otherwise.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns the parent chain and child chain pricing state at evenly spaced blocks between `start` and `end`, with at most the configured block range bound of samples.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns the size of the retryable timeout queue at evenly spaced blocks between `start` and `end`, with at most the configured block range bound of samples.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns the retryable tickets in the timeout queue at the given block, with the timeout of each queue entry in Unix seconds, or 0 if the retryable no longer exists. Returns at most one entry more than the configured timeout queue bound.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Adds the signed transaction to the transaction pool, waits until it is included in a block, and returns the receipt. Returns an error if the timeout ends first.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Submits a signed raw transaction that the sequencer includes only if the given options hold: the parent chain block number and the block timestamp ranges, and the storage of the known accounts. Returns the transaction hash.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Stores the message until the given timeout and returns the serialized data availability certificate.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Opens a chunked store of a message of `totalSize` bytes, sent as `nChunks` chunks of `chunkSize` bytes, and returns the message ID to pass to `daprovider_sendChunk` and `daprovider_commitChunkedStore`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Adds the chunk with the given chunk ID to the chunked store opened for the given message ID. Returns `null`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Assembles the chunks received for the given message ID, stores the message and returns the serialized data availability certificate.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Opens a chunked store of a message of `totalSize` bytes, sent as `nChunks` chunks of `chunkSize` bytes, and returns the message ID to pass to `das_sendChunk` and `das_commitChunkedStore`. Requests that are too old or replayed are rejected.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Adds the chunk with the given chunk ID to the chunked store opened for the given message ID. Returns `null`.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Assembles the chunks received for the given message ID, stores the message and returns the signed data availability certificate.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.

post.description: Returns an error if the storage backend of the data availability server is not healthy. Returns `null` otherwise.

200.description: JSON-RPC response. HTTP status is 200 for both a result and an error.
